stemText: In cyanobacteria like Nostoc and Anabaena, which specialized, thick-walled cells are responsible for biological nitrogen fixation under anaerobic conditions?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Heterocysts are specialized pale, thick-walled vegetative cells in cyanobacteria.
Step 2: They create an impermeable barrier to atmospheric oxygen.
Step 3: This protects the nitrogenase enzyme from irreversible oxygen inactivation, allowing conversion of N2 to NH3.
Step 4: Conclude Option B is correct.

translations.stemText: நாஸ்டாக் மற்றும் அனபினா போன்ற சயனோபாக்டீரியாக்களில், காற்றில்லா சூழலில் உயிரியல் நைட்ரஜன் நிலைநிறுத்தத்திற்கு காரணமான சிறப்பு தடித்த சுவர் கொண்ட செல்கள் யாவை?
optionTexts: ஹெட்டிரோசிஸ்ட்டுகள் (ஆக்ஸிஜன் உணர்திறன் கொண்ட நைட்ரோஜினேஸ் என்சைமைப் பெற்றுள்ளன)

stemText: In pteridophytes, the phenomenon of heterospory (production of distinct microspores and megaspores as seen in Selaginella and Salvinia) is considered a critical evolutionary precursor to:

options.label: B
options.text: Seed habit (origin of the seed in spermatophytes)

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Heterospory produces two types of spores: microspores (male gametophyte) and megaspores (female gametophyte).
Step 2: Retention of the female gametophyte within the megasporangium on the parent sporophyte provides embryo nourishment.
Step 3: This development represents the critical evolutionary stepping-stone to the seed habit of gymnosperms and angiosperms.
Step 4: Conclude Option B is correct.

Step 3: (r-Phycoerythrin is found in red algae Rhodophyceae).
Step 4: Conclude Option D is correct.

stemText: Which group of fungi is commonly known as 'Fungi Imperfecti' because they reproduce exclusively through asexual spores (conidia) and completely lack any known sexual stage?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Deuteromycetes is an artificial fungal class for fungi that lack a known teleomorph (sexual stage).
Step 2: They reproduce solely by asexual conidiospores.
Step 3: When a sexual stage is discovered, they are transferred to Ascomycetes or Basidiomycetes.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.
